headline: Krishival Foods discloses outcome of its right issue committee meeting
hook: Krishival Foods announces right issue committee outcome
summary: Krishival Foods Limited informed the stock exchange that the committee overseeing its proposed rights issue met on October 17, 2026 and released its findings. The filing indicates the company is moving forward with a capital‑raising plan that could involve issuing additional shares to existing shareholders. Existing shareholders may see their ownership diluted if they do not participate in the rights issue. Retail investors should watch for the upcoming subscription terms and pricing details.
why_it_matters: Potential share dilution for existing shareholders
